remarks: Welcome to 23 Rogers Dr, a tastefully updated, move-in ready 3 bedroom, 2 full bath ranch located in the Depew School District! The charming front porch welcomes you into the home, where you will find a comfortable living room w/ recessed lighting that flows seamlessly into the dining area, creating an open and functional layout. The first floor also features a beautifully renovated kitchen with included SS appliances, 3 bedrooms, and a full bathroom. Luxury vinyl plank flooring runs throughout the first floor, with tile flooring in the kitchen. The mostly finished, dry basement offers additional living space complete w/ built-in cabinetry (wine chiller & mini fridge included), a second full bathroom, and a dedicated laundry room. The home also features central A/C and sump pump w/ battery backup for added peace of mind. Step outside to the fully fenced backyard featuring a covered paver patio and a built-in paver fire pit area, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Additional exterior features include a 1-car detached garage, low-maintenance vinyl and stone exterior, and Govee year-round exterior lighting. Numerous updates include a smart Ecobee thermostat (19'), recessed living room lighting and partial basement remodel (20'), remodeled kitchen and HWT (21'), updated electric panels, luxury vinyl plank flooring and interior doors (24'), roof replacement (25'), some newer vinyl windows, and recently refreshed interior paint. With its extensive updates, functional layout, and inviting outdoor space, this home is truly move-in ready! Showings begin Wednesday, October 21st at 10am. Offers are due Thursday, October 29th at 12pm.
